name: Psychopath
ability: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.
interaction: Each day before nominations may publicly choose one player, who dies. When executed, plays roshambo against the nominator (or the Storyteller if self-nominated).
drunk_or_poisoned: The day kill does nothing (target survives). If executed while drunk or poisoned, the Psychopath dies without roshambo.

jinxes.text: If the Psychopath is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.

rulings.text: Once per day, before nominations; the choice is public.
If executed, roshambo with the nominator; dies only on a loss. A draw or win means survival, but the execution still counts as the day's execution.
If self-nominated, roshambo against the Storyteller.
Deaths other than execution (e.g. Demon attack) involve no roshambo.

test_scenarios.name: day kill
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Psychopath, Bob Empath, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2 before nominations: Alice publicly chooses Bob.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob dies; Alice cannot kill again that day.

test_scenarios.name: executed wins roshambo
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Psychopath; Dave Chef nominates Alice.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is executed; Alice wins roshambo.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice survives; no further nominations that day.

test_scenarios.name: executed loses roshambo
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Psychopath; Dave Chef nominates Alice.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is executed; Alice loses roshambo.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Psychopath poisoned by Erin Poisoner, Bob Monk.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: Alice chooses Bob; later Alice is executed.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob survives; Alice dies on execution without roshambo.
